data.title: OS Therapies: Regulatory Momentum for Herlystic Supports Continued Buy Rating with Unchanged $6 Price Target
data.description:
Analyst Jason McCarthy of Maxim Group maintained a Buy rating on OS Therapies Incorporated, retaining the price target of $6.00.

Jason McCarthy has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors, primarily centered on the advancing regulatory profile of Herlystic, OS Therapies’ lead osteosarcoma immunotherapy. He views the recent alignment among MHRA, EMA, and FDA on trial design, historical controls, and the use of accelerated pathways as materially reducing regulatory uncertainty and enhancing the probability of approval.

Jason also emphasizes the near-term catalysts that could unlock significant value, including the planned UK Conditional Marketing Authorization Application submission, the forthcoming final three-year overall survival data, and the anticipated completion of the U.S. BLA under the Accelerated Approval route. With the $6 price target unchanged, he believes the current valuation does not fully reflect these regulatory milestones and the potential economic upside from designations such as the Rare Pediatric Disease PRV, supporting his continued Buy recommendation on OSTX.

data.title: Meridian Mining: Robust Cabaçal Economics and Advancing Development Underpin Higher Target Price and Buy Rating
data.description:
Andrew Mikitchook, an analyst from BMO Capital, maintained the Buy rating on Meridian Mining SE. The associated price target is C$3.75.

Andrew Mikitchook has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors, including the robust economics outlined in Meridian’s updated feasibility work for the Cabaçal deposit. The study points to low projected all-in sustaining costs, strong anticipated annual gold-equivalent output in the early years, and a rapid payback period, together supporting attractive project returns and a higher target price.

Andrew Mikitchook’s rating is based on Meridian’s visible path to development and financing, as well as the project’s positioning in a market short on new mines. He highlights that permitting and early pre-construction activities are already underway, while the company is actively engaged with a broad group of potential lenders, suggesting that the increased capital cost remains manageable and that progress toward first production should drive further share price revaluation.

data.title: Nuvectis Oncology Reaffirmed at Buy as Analyst Cites Differentiated BRAF Pipeline and Maintains $30 Price Target
data.description:
In a report released yesterday, Naz Rahman from Maxim Group reiterated a Buy rating on Nuvectis Pharma, with a price target of $30.00.

Naz Rahman has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors, primarily centered on the differentiated oncology pipeline Nuvectis is advancing. He highlights NXP200 as a next‑generation, brain‑penetrant BRAF inhibitor designed to overcome resistance and safety limitations seen with first‑generation BRAF therapies, addressing a clear unmet medical need in difficult‑to‑treat gliomas and other BRAF‑mutated tumors.

Rahman also points to meaningful external validation, noting the Breakthrough Therapy Designation for NXP200 in China and the strong data and BTD status of a similar BRAF inhibitor, plixorafenib, which together support the potential for best‑in‑class efficacy. He believes Nuvectis can leverage Haisco’s development work and data as it prepares a U.S. IND in 4Q26, reinforcing the long‑term value proposition while maintaining an unchanged $30 price target.

data.description:

Charles Brennan has given his Sell rating due to a combination of factors, primarily his view that Dassault Systemes is mired in a prolonged phase of subdued growth. data.title: Cipher Maintained at Buy as Analyst Highlights $9B Barber Lake Colocation Deals and Reaffirms $30 Price Target
data.description:
Mike Colonnese, an analyst from H.C. Wainwright, reiterated the Buy rating on Cipher Digital. The associated price target remains the same with $30.00.

Mike Colonnese has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors tied to Cipher’s expanding, highly contracted revenue base at Barber Lake. The new follow-on agreements extend the site’s contract term to 20 years and lift total committed colocation revenue to more than $9 billion, with economics that compare favorably to similar large-scale AI data center leases and project-level margins estimated at roughly 85%.

He also views the structured cost-sharing on incremental capex, the fully funded initial Barber Lake budget, and the plan to use mostly debt for added spending as supportive of long‑term returns. Colonnese’s unchanged $30 price target reflects a sum‑of‑the‑parts approach, combining the BTC mining segment with sizable, contracted data center income, while acknowledging risks such as Bitcoin price volatility, construction timing, and potential equity dilution.

Alessio Olmi has given his Buy rating due to a combination of factors tied to Italian Wine Brands’ ability to navigate a weak market while preserving profitability. Despite a decline in H1 2026 sales and volumes, the group continued to outperform Italian wine exports overall, with its Top Brands segment showing solid volume growth and strong direct margins that support overall earnings quality.
